nodes.label: EPS secret-key HMAC signing scheme
nodes.rationale: secret-key = base64(HMAC-SHA256(message = timestamp_ms, key = base64(access_key))). The HMAC key is the base64 STRING used as-is; base64-decoding it back to raw bytes before signing produces a different signature and a 403. The signature binds the request to a timestamp so it must be regenerated per call.

nodes.label: Access Key vs Developer Key
nodes.rationale: The access_key (a.k.a. auth key) is never sent on the wire — it only computes the secret-key. The developer_key is sent as a static header. Nothing secret travels in plain form.

nodes.label: SecretKeyTester browser playground
nodes.rationale: Signs entirely in-browser with the Web Crypto API so the access key is never sent to Eko or stored — safe as a scratchpad, explicitly flagged as NOT a pattern to copy into a real integration.
